speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Tumor of the Bone

The imaging findings of a "soap bubble" lytic lesion in the distal femur are highly characteristic of this condition, which commonly affects young adults and often causes pain that disrupts sleep. The slightly elevated ESR can occur in benign bone tumors, while the normal inflammatory markers and lack of fever help rule out infection. Are you experiencing any recent trauma or mechanical instability in the knee?
